records.title: Context-aware Biases for Length Extrapolation
records.reason: The work studies positional biases for length extrapolation and model behavior; it gives no concrete inference optimization or serving-cost reduction.

records.title: Determinant Estimation under Memory Constraints and Neural Scaling Laws
records.reason: Determinant estimation under memory constraints is a mathematical/statistical estimation problem, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Dynamics of "Spontaneous" Topic Changes in Next Token Prediction with Self-Attention
records.reason: This analyzes topic changes in next-token prediction/self-attention; it studies model behavior without reducing inference cost.

records.title: Can Models Help Us Create Better Models? Evaluating LLMs as Data Scientists
records.reason: The paper evaluates LLMs as data scientists for dataset creation; this capability assessment does not optimize model inference.

records.title: From Text to Emoji: How PEFT-Driven Personality Manipulation Unleashes the Emoji Potential in LLMs
records.reason: PEFT-driven personality/emoji manipulation is a model behavior/application study, not an inference-efficiency contribution.
